message: Thanks for reaching out. I'll ask a few quick questions to see which programmes you may qualify for. First: which state do you live in?
Thanks. Are there any children under 18 living with you? If so, how many?
Roughly how much does your household earn from work in a year, before tax?

summary: Household: two adults in their thirties and one child under 18, in Georgia, with about $250,000 in annual earned income. This is well above the income limits for all ten programmes. SNAP, WIC, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, SSI, school meals and EITC are income-tested and out of reach at this income. The ACA premium tax credit is capped at about 400% of the federal poverty level, far below this income. The refundable part of the child tax credit requires earned income in a range that this household exceeds, and its non-refundable part phases out only above $400,000 for married couples, so the refundable portion does not apply. No programmes are recommended. Other income, assets and expenses were not asked, since the earned income alone rules everything out.
